articles.title: Fat Bear Week: Vote for the Chubbiest Champion!
articles.summary: It's Fat Bear Week in Alaska! You can vote online for the fattest brown bear at Katmai National Park. Last year, more than 1.7 million votes came in from over 100 countries.

articles.title: Thieves Steal Trailers, Find 20 Tons of Sand Inside
articles.summary: Thieves in California stole two trailers with Nvidia logos, hoping for fancy tech. Instead, they got 40,000 pounds of sand! The trailers were later returned.

articles.title: Alcaraz Smiles After 3:34am Loss: 'I Suffered, But I Enjoyed'
articles.summary: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set match at 3:34am but walked off smiling. He said he missed the feeling of competing after a wrist injury kept him out for months.
